description:
Create a 2.5D isometric game asset icon from the BMW benchmark car.

Steps:
1. Remove or hide the floor/background plane so only the car is visible.
2. Configure the camera for a True Isometric view:
   - Type: Orthographic
   - Rotation X: 54.7 degrees (approx 35.3 deg depression)
   - Rotation Z: 45 degrees
   - Adjust Orthographic Scale so the car fills ~80-90% of the frame.
3. Configure Render settings:
   - Resolution: 512 x 512 px
   - Film: Enable 'Transparent' to support alpha channel.
4. Render the image and save it to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/iso_icon.png'.
5. Save the Blender project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/iso_setup.blend'.
